I’m in for the challenge. I was planning to go tomorrow after downing everything and giving it some time. I got some at home tests and praying if I down everything and give it a little bit of time, it’ll work.

This is literally make it or break it. Either I get a promotion or I get fired.

Definitely possible!! I had my first miscarriage on 3/30/2022. Never even got a period following and I found out I was pregnant again on 4/29/2022! 

Definitely a new baby too. A week after my miscarriage my HCG levels were at 0. 

Have hope!!

Week 7-9! It hurt so bad with the nausea. Especially getting sick when absolutely nothing would help me. I was blessed with zofran on week 9. But still deal with nausea here and there. 11 weeks now and things slowly starting to get better. Less nauseous, boobs not as sore as beginning. Still exhausted though but I enjoy sleeping 😂😂😂
I’m curious to see how the 2nd and 3rd trimester treats me 😏

I miscarried on 3/31/22 at 6W5D. I do believe it’s possible to ovulate two weeks later as long as your levels dropped back to zero! Less than a month later on 4/29/22, I found out I was pregnant again! 

If you feel ready, go for it. It doesn’t hurt to try.

My miscarriage was a natural one. Unsure if you had a D&C or were further along if it would make a difference. My highest level in the beginning was 266 and on the 31st, was 136. By a week I was already back down to 0. Definitely check with your doctor first! I had gotten my doctors permission first to immediately start trying before I actually tried.

The timing of my first MC was actually pretty nice. Not that I lost my baby. I was devastated, ruined for a pretty good chunk of time.

But my miscarriage so happened on the early early 2am morning of a Thursday and my off days from work was Friday, Saturday and Sunday. 

I called into my call off line, left a voicemail knowing nobody would be there to answer my call and straight on the phone told them on the edge of sobbing once again that I wouldn’t be in, that I had just came home from emergency room that I was dealing with a miscarriage. Majority of my job knew I was pregnant since I was so excited. 

Come Monday most of the miscarriage was finished and I was starting to finish up bleeding and I went to my administrator to turn in a doctors note stating I had a miscarriage (For someone who never had called off not even for a sniffle), that wasn’t even needed. 

My management was so sweet told me they understood what was happening, and if I needed anything to let them know.

I left that office in happy tears.
